country_data.national_population_reference_source: Statistics Botswana, Agricultural Census 2025 Stats Brief: Livestock Sector (September 2026)
country_data.national_population_reference_note: National herd inventory reference only; census population, births and deaths are not sale weights, offtake rates, farmgate prices or production costs. The census results are provisional.
country_data.official_processor_price_source: Botswana Meat Commission, cattle buying FAQ; stated carcass-mass prices for eligible cattle at BMC Lobatse
country_data.official_processor_price_note: Processor carcass-mass buying prices, not liveweight farmgate prices. EU price requires grading and compliance; Other Markets price differs. BMC Lobatse zone and animal eligibility restrictions apply. Not used as the calculator's generic live-animal selling-price assumption.
country_data.bmc_minimum_carcass_weight_reference_sou: Botswana Meat Commission cattle buying FAQ; BMC states it buys ready-to-slaughter cattle weighing 160 kg carcass mass and above.
country_data.bmc_minimum_carcass_weight_reference_not: Eligibility threshold at BMC; carcass mass is not liveweight. BMC's EU market requires additional zone, age, traceability and compliance conditions.
country_data.smallholder_cattle_cost_study_source: Otieno et al., Productive efficiency of beef cattle production in Botswana: a latent class stochastic meta-frontier analysis, Frontiers in Sustainable Food Systems (2023), survey production-unit descriptive statistics.
country_data.smallholder_cattle_cost_study_note: Study sample mean input costs per production unit, not a standardized per-head annual budget or current 2026 quote. The unit represents a surveyed farm/production unit; values are context only and are not used as calculator cost_per_unit.
country_data.cattle_transport_cost_market_reference_s: Farmers' Platform expert column, Botswana's Crippled Beef Industry, 1 October 2026; reports that farmers in remote areas may face transport costs of approximately P1,500 per animal.
country_data.cattle_transport_cost_market_reference_n: Reported farmer/industry estimate for some remote routes, not a universal freight tariff or farm-specific cost. Transport distance, loading, holding and route conditions vary; not used as a generic calculator cost.
